repository.divergence_summary: Local HEAD (fixer-wave-s01-s09-remediation @ 84aa9e4) is the source branch that was merged into origin/main via PR #17, producing origin/main @ 316fc14. Local main was not fast-forwarded; it is 1 commit behind origin/main. The live site is built from origin/main on every push to main.

deployment.static_export_strategy: Disposable mkdtemp copy; src/app/api is rmSync'd from the copy only; tracked working tree is never mutated. Webpack (not Turbopack) is used because Turbopack rejects node_modules symlinks outside project root.

divergences_identified.description: Section 40 ID in section source file vs Prisma seed file disagree.
divergences_identified.impact: When the dynamic LMS seeds the QuestionBank table, section 40's questions are stored under sectionId='agentic-architecture'. The ExamView client calls POST /api/exam/start with sectionId='architecture-ddd-decisions' (the section source id). The exam/start route looks up db.questionBank.findMany({ where: { sectionId } }) — it will return zero questions for section 40. Section 40 exams are silently broken on the dynamic LMS. The static public site does not run exams so it is unaffected.
